$comment: Ratchet baseline for tools/check-cycles.js. Only ever lower these.
$note: P17 (W5a) step 2 measured 16 cycles and closed every host one, leaving the
nine the vendored submodules own (eight in path.ux, one in mathl).
Three knots, three fixes, none of them a budget raise:
adapter imported simplemesh.ts for the PrimitiveTypes enum alone, which
dragged in the shader stack and the WebGPU queue. The enum family moved
to the new leaf webgl/primitive_types.ts; simplemesh re-exports it.
view3d <-> view3d_toolmode (four cycles): the toolmode base imported the
editor it is hosted by, for DrawLine (already defined in view3d_base and
merely re-exported by view3d) and ITempText. ITempText moved down to
the two return edges were an already-type-only ViewContext in
texture/proceduralTex.ts and an outright unused `import {ViewContext}` in
The host budget is 0 and there is no outstanding exception. core/context.ts
still value-imports seven editor classes to use as getContextArea() keys;
that no longer closes a cycle, but it is why core cannot be embedded without
the editors, and a name-keyed lookup would finish the job.
